sections.title: Find Your Place: Exploring Philadelphia, Penn, and Your Own Story
sections.description: Philadelphia has always been a city of stories—of people coming from all over the world, as well as families who’ve been here for generations. The University of Pennsylvania is part of that story, too. In this course, you’ll get to know the city and campus in a hands-on, creative way. We’ll use maps, photos, poetry, stories, and even walking tours to explore what it means to find a place to belong. You’ll dive into the hard and inspiring history of both Philly and Penn, learn about immigrants and newcomers who shaped the city, and reflect on your own journey—how you got here and where you’re headed. By the end, you’ll not only know more about this place, but you’ll also have your own story to tell about your path to Penn.
